title: The live frame a connector answers to connector.live_frame
description: What happens on track now, in the data model's vocabulary and units, built by the connector only when asked (connector-protocol.md section 7). 'null' means the game does not give the value now. While phase is garage, on_track or paused, the groups session, track, car, lap and participants are required, and participants holds at least one car with is_player true. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored by Pitwall.

data_age_s.description: Seconds since the game last updated what the frame was built from.

time_remaining_s.description: Session time left, s; null in a lap race or when not given.

laps_in_event.description: Laps of a lap race; null in a timed session.

duration_s.description: Length of a timed session, s; null in a lap race.

additional_laps.description: Laps to drive after the time runs out in a timed race (0 = none).

started.description: Optional: false before the start of a race (grid, formation lap), true once started; null or absent when not known or not a race.

penalty.description: Optional: a penalty the game has pending for the player; null = none or not known.

lap.description: The player's lap now. Required in a session: without it Pitwall answers its live tools with not_on_track.

current_lap.description: The game's number of the lap being driven.

distance_m.description: Lap distance from the start/finish line, m (may be slightly negative or above the length around the line).

time_s.description: Lap clock of the lap being driven, s; null while not timed (out lap, pits, before the start).

valid.description: False once the game invalidated the lap.

best_lap_s.description: The player's best lap of this session, by the game.

lap_type.description: Optional: the data model's lap type of the lap being driven, as far as the connector knows it now; null = not known.

invalid_cause.description: Optional: why valid is false; null or absent when valid or not given.

invalid_cause_certain.description: Optional: false when invalid_cause is only the probable cause.

invalid_at_m.description: Optional: lap distance where the game flagged the lap invalid, m.

splits.description: The game's own time gaps of the player to the car ahead and behind, s; null when not given. Pitwall uses them in races only.

conditions.description: Weather; every field optional (the write API's conditions).

cloud.description: Cloud cover, 0..1; leave out a value on another scale.

participants.description: Every car in the session, the player's included. At least one participant with is_player true is required in a session, even for a game with one car; Pitwall takes the first such participant as the player.

slug.description: Lowercase id: letters, digits, '_' and '-', 1..32 characters, starting with a letter or digit.

id.description: Opaque catalogue id (the write API's ids).

time.description: ISO 8601 date and time with a UTC offset, for example 2026-01-02T18:00:00.123+02:00.

phase.description: 'menus' (not in a session: main menus, loading, replays, restarting), 'garage' (in a session, the player's car in the garage), 'on_track' (driving, the pit lane included), 'paused' (in a session out of the garage, the game paused or an in-session menu over the car on track).

pit_mode.description: Pit mode code (data-model.md): 0 on track, 1 driving into the pits, 2 in the pit box, 3 driving out of the pits or the garage, 4 in the garage.

tread_in_c.description: Tread temperature, inner edge (towards the centreline), C.

index.description: The game's participant index (may be reused by another driver in a session).

active.description: False for a slot the game lists but that is not in the session now. Required: Pitwall drops an inactive slot from the rivals, gaps and neighbours.
